messages.guide.title: Start with your first film
messages.guide.description: Explore Studio with a local example, then connect your model service.
messages.guide.example-description: Three scenes on one timeline. Play the film, change a title or background color, and see how a project comes together.
messages.guide.example-meta: 9 seconds · 960 × 540 · 30 fps · No API Key needed
messages.guide.lesson-play-description: Open the example and press Play below the preview. Seek to seconds 3 and 6 to see the background and title change.
messages.guide.lesson-edit-description: Select the leftmost color wash clip in backgrounds. Open Properties → Style → Color, enter a color and press Tab; or edit Hello, Hypit. in scene.svml. Source changes save after you stop typing.
messages.guide.lesson-save-description: Property and timeline edits save automatically. Source edits save after typing stops; Cmd/Ctrl+S saves immediately. The bundled original stays intact and your practice copy persists.
messages.guide.files-description: scene.svml defines content and timing; styles.svs holds appearance rules; preview.svrun selects the preview target.
messages.guide.reopen: Resume this copy later (run from the repository root):
messages.guide.separate-example: You are viewing your own Run. To try the bundled example, run the command below in another terminal and open its printed URL.
messages.guide.copy-error: Select the text and copy it manually
messages.guide.next-description: The local example needs no account. To generate images, speech, or video, create a runtime and configure credentials for your provider.
messages.guide.runtime-restart: After initialization from the repository root, restart Studio and save your key on the API Key page. The default runtime uses HypiHub.
messages.guide.faq-export: Is preview the same as video export?
messages.guide.faq-export-answer: No. This example previews a local composition and does not automatically render an MP4. Export needs a rendering runtime, its dependencies, and a Run with a video output target.
messages.guide.faq-cost: Does the example use a paid service?
messages.guide.faq-cost-answer: Preview uses installed fonts and local drawing, with no remote model calls. A configured key only means it is saved; provider charges may apply when you explicitly execute generation tasks.
messages.guide.faq-existing: How do I open my project?
messages.guide.faq-existing-answer: Run node bin/hypit.mjs studio --run path/to/preview.svrun. See examples/README.md for other projects; generation examples require additional setup.
messages.guide.footer: Return here anytime from Guide. Commands assume a source checkout; for an installed CLI, replace node bin/hypit.mjs with hypit.
messages.guide.tour-preview-description: This shows the current frame. Use Play below the preview, or Space to play/pause. The built-in example changes scenes at seconds 3 and 6.
messages.guide.tour-timeline: Find a scene on the timeline
messages.guide.tour-timeline-description: Each row is a track; clips define when content appears. Click the time ruler to seek, then select a clip to inspect its properties.
messages.guide.tour-properties-description: Select a clip and open Style in Properties. In the built-in example, choose the leftmost backgrounds clip, change Color and press Tab to update the preview and save.
messages.guide.tour-source-description: In the Source panel, click Edit source to change a title. Edits save after typing stops, or with Cmd/Ctrl+S. Finish to return to file locations and API Key setup.
messages.guide.lesson-save-own: Changes write directly to this project’s source. Source edits save after typing stops, or with Cmd/Ctrl+S. Open the bundled example separately to practice on a copy.
